Maria (sales): Hey team — acme.health legal asked for our pen-test artifacts + remediation timeline. They want checksums and a point person for each finding by EOD tomorrow. I uploaded a staging bundle to S3, link below. Can sec + eng confirm the bundle and owners?

Josh (eng): Thanks Maria. Link? I'll sanity-check the logs and vuln list.

Maria (sales): s3://redwood-sales-artifacts/acme-health/2026-03-20/ — read-only link: https://s3.redwood.example/acme-health/2026-03-20 (expires in 7d)

Kevin (security): I'll run through the CVEs and map them to our tracking tickets. Quick ask: include SHA256 checksums and an export of the scanner XML so customer can verify.

Anika (solutions): Also need the pen-tester's scope doc and red-team report summary for the SOC review. I can attach a redacted PDF.

Josh (eng): On it. I'll post checksums here shortly. Running `sha256sum` against the artifact bundle now.

security-bot: Automated scan note — external-scan-2026-03-18 finished. 42 findings (13 high, 18 medium, 11 low). Report ID: scan-2026-0318-42.

Kevin (security): Good. Maria — we'll assign remediation owners per finding class (infra, runtime config, dependency updates). Can you confirm customer's requirement for egress IP allowlist? They asked about static IPs for webhook callbacks.

Maria (sales): They requested fixed egress IPs for audit traffic and an S3 pre-signed upload test. They also asked if we can provide a temporary staging environment with RBAC + audit logs for them to validate artifacts.

Josh (eng): We can provide a dedicated staging bucket and a short-lived VPC endpoint. For IPs: we'll provide the egress-ips.csv with the current list, but note that Dedicated customers can get reserved IPs — hosted may have some variability.

Kevin (security): I created tickets and mapped preliminary owners. Example mapping: infra => @Josh, deps => @Anika, config => @Kevin. I'll dump the ticket IDs and short remediation ETA in the ticket later.

Josh (eng): Checksums: `sha256sum artifacts-bundle.tar.gz` => `3b2f9c8a1e4d7c6e9a7f4a2b1c8d9f0a3e4b5c6d7e8f9a0b1c2d3e4f5a6b7c8`. XML export: `scanner-export-acme-20260318.xml` uploaded.

Anika (solutions): Uploaded redacted report to the bucket at `redacted_acme_report_v1.pdf`. I redacted customer-specific URLs + test accounts.

Kevin (security): I'll add a remediation timeline: high findings — initial triage 24h, patch/proof 72h, customer verification 5 business days after fix. Medium/low staggered. I'll post formal timeline doc to the bucket.

Maria (sales): Perfect. Customer asked for a simple handoff doc listing: artifacts + checksums, ticket owners, contact for escalations, and timeline. Can we have that ready as `acme-handoff-README.md` in the bucket?

Josh (eng): I'll draft the README now. Will include sample verification commands: e.g., `curl -I https://s3.redwood.example/acme-health/2026-03-20/artifacts-bundle.tar.gz` and checksum verification steps.

Kevin (security): Note for legal: we've redacted PII and test keys. Also confirming no production customer data in these artifacts.

Maria (sales): Thanks — please ping when README + timeline are in. I'll coordinate with the customer's security contact to schedule a verification call.

Josh (eng): README uploaded: s3://redwood-sales-artifacts/acme-health/2026-03-20/acme-handoff-README.md. Contents include checksums, ticket IDs, who-to-contact list, and verification steps.

Kevin (security): Timeline doc uploaded: `acme_remediation_timeline_v1.md`. Highs targeted within 3 business days, with weekly updates to the customer.

Anika (solutions): Added a brief how-to for verifying the scanner XML in the README and a note about the redaction approach.

Maria (sales): Great — I'll send the S3 link + README to Acme security now. Tagging @AcmeSec contact in the email. Will follow up with a verification call invite. :pray:

Josh (eng): One more note — for any fixes that require model rebuilds or quantization changes we need a slightly longer window. I'll flag those tickets.

Kevin (security): Understood. I'll also include a statement about standard-of-care patching and CVSS thresholds in the README.

Maria (sales): Thanks everyone. I'll close this thread once customer confirms receipt.

security-bot: Reminder — please append S3 ACL screenshot for audit trail to the README.
